title: 3D phone lab interaction checks passed
summary: Explore phone hardware and software through a rotatable 3D model, component lessons, iPhone/Android comparisons, a quiz and saved learning progress.

changes.detail: Offline self-contained perspective 3D cuboid model with depth ordering, face hit testing, drag/keyboard rotation, front/back controls, exploded layers and software view. Named topic buttons provide an accessible alternative.

14 English/French/Arabic topics with explanations and everyday examples, broad iPhone/Android comparison, photo processing walkthrough and RAM/storage knowledge check. Official Apple and Android reading links; clearly labeled simplified educational model.
Web iframe and native WebView renderers with validated message bridges, saved understood-topic checklist and entry points on Home and More. Existing phone remote-control screen is unchanged.
